title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About the role:
We are hiring a Senior ML Engineer to build production model-training and serving infrastructure that powers our document-retrieval platform.

Responsibilities:
- Design and ship model-training and serving pipelines
- Own experiment tracking, evaluation, and drift monitoring
- Collaborate with research and product to move from prototype to production
- Mentor engineers on ML system design

Requirements:
- Strong Python and PyTorch experience
- 5+ years shipping ML systems in production
- Familiarity with MLflow, Airflow, and GCP or AWS
- Experience with embeddings and RAG systems

Nice to have:
- Vertex AI experience
- Prior work on LLM applications

title: MLOps Engineer
description:
The role:
Own the ML platform end-to-end at a fast-growing infra company.

What you'll do:
- Operate Airflow orchestration and the MLflow model registry
- Ship Docker and Kubernetes deployments for training and inference
- Automate CI/CD via GitHub Actions and Terraform
- Instrument monitoring with Evidently

Requirements:
- Fluent Python
- Comfortable with AWS or GCP
- Experience productionizing PyTorch and scikit-learn models

Bonus:
- Terraform expertise
- Prior on-call for ML systems

title: Enterprise Sales Executive
description:
About the role:
Drive net-new enterprise revenue with hospital systems.

Responsibilities:
- Manage a quota against a defined territory
- Run CRM hygiene in Salesforce
- Build a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities

Requirements:
- Six-plus years of complex B2B SaaS sales
- Track record of closing $500K+ deals

Preferred:
- Healthcare or hospital systems experience
